global_sequence_scope: one shared monotonically increasing sequence across these exact three accounts; never reset on account change
page_campaign_sequence_scope: C01,C02,... advances for the same pg token across the same three accounts; preserve observed previous Cnn/Cnnn history
history_reader_purpose: explicit read-only naming reference across the three allowlisted corporate accounts, using the existing contracted advertiser identity; never credential fallback or binding for campaign writes on another account
page_lookup: Smart Bidding Messenger row selected by exact whole UTM_CAMPAIGN pg token; require unique FB_PAGE_ID/PAGE_NAME and exact Meta GET identity; never use the hypothetical example as a request
utm_campaign: exact pg token of selected Page; independent of global numeric prefix
adset_name_scope: new campaign requests in this group; current tested campaign adset explicitly renamed under this message
existing_campaign_names: preserved; no retroactive campaign renaming requested
clone_campaign_naming: existing clone contracts remain unchanged; this policy supplies the requested new-creation naming
reservation: atomic shared ledger, request+account idempotency; live complete histories of all three and existing reservations prevent duplicates; no allocation without a real request
supersedes: For future from-zero requests in this group only: per-Page stable numeric prefix, missing separator before C, C001 formatting and AdG1 default. Historical requests/manifests remain versioned.
preserved_gates: account scope and per-account operational readiness
